mapper.select: SELECT e.*, pt.* FROM employee AS e JOIN ( SELECT team.department_id, parent.department_type, team.department_name, team.department_status FROM department team JOIN department parent ON team.parent_department_id = parent.department_id ORDER BY parent.department_type ASC, team.department_name ASC ) AS pt ON e.department_id = pt.department_id
SELECT e.*, d.* FROM employee e JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.department_type) AS total_department_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.department_name) AS total_department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS total_employee_id FROM employee AS e JOIN ( SELECT team.department_id, parent.department_type, team.department_name FROM department team JOIN department parent ON team.parent_department_id = parent.department_id ORDER BY parent.department_type ASC, team.department_name ASC ) AS pt ON e.department_id = pt.department_id
